links.outcome: Clinically significant errors resolved, remaining or newly introduced after LLM error correction of ASR output
links.effect: Proportion of outputs affected fell from 53% to 30%; of 89 significant errors, 51 resolved, 38 remained, 4 newly introduced (new errors in 3% of outputs).

links.quote: Reference-transcript length significantly increased odds of Class 3 errors for 4 systems (GPT4oTranscribe, Tortus, Amazon-Medical-Transcribe, Dragon-Medical-One; odds ratio 2.65-3.34/additional 100 reference-words).
